'''Qi Seasoning''' can be purchased from [[Qi's Walnut Room]] once unlocked.  The price is 10 Qi Seasoning for 10 {{Name|Qi Gem|class=inline}}s.

Having Qi Seasoning in the [[Inventory]], the refrigerator, or a [[Mini-Fridge]] will cause any dishes that the player [[cooking|cooks]] to become gold quality. The Qi Seasoning will be consumed on use.

Gold quality cooked dishes sell for 50% more than their normal quality counterparts, and recover 80% more health and energy when consumed. Gold quality dishes also give better buffs when eaten, adding +1 to the stats (excluding [[Speed]] buffs). The duration of the buffs are also increased by 50%.
